title: Cotelligent Felicitation Policy — Work Anniversary Rewards

sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The Felicitation Policy recognizes and celebrates the loyalty and long-term commitment of Cotelligent associates. This policy applies to all full-time permanent employees of Cotelligent who complete significant work anniversaries with the organization.

sections.title: Work Anniversary Milestones and Rewards
paragraphs: Cotelligent felicitates employees at the following milestones: 5 Years of Service, 10 Years of Service, and 15 Years of Service.

5-Year Anniversary: Employees completing 5 years of service are recognized with a certificate of appreciation and a gift voucher. The exact denomination of the gift voucher is communicated by the HR department.

10-Year Anniversary: Employees completing 10 years of service receive a certificate of appreciation, a commemorative memento, and an enhanced gift voucher. This milestone is celebrated with special recognition at a team or company event.

15-Year Anniversary: Employees completing 15 years of service are felicitated with a certificate of appreciation, a premium commemorative memento, and a premium gift voucher. This milestone receives the highest level of recognition within the organization.

sections.title: Eligibility Criteria
paragraphs: To be eligible for felicitation, the associate must: be on the payroll as a full-time permanent employee on the date of the anniversary, not be serving a notice period, and must not have any active disciplinary proceedings against them.
Associates on long-term leave (beyond 3 months) on the anniversary date may have their felicitation deferred to when they return to active duty.

sections.title: Process and Administration
paragraphs: The HR department maintains records of all employee joining dates and proactively identifies upcoming anniversaries. The HR team coordinates the felicitation ceremony or recognition event.

Felicitations may be conducted during company town halls, team meetings, or dedicated recognition events. The HR team will contact the employee's reporting manager at least one month in advance to plan the celebration.
Gift vouchers and mementos are arranged by the HR department. Employees are not required to submit any request for this; the process is entirely managed by HR.
